author: Carlos Martinez
title: Rally Chile 2019: My Stage Side Clips
description: I filmed Rally Chile 2019 on my phone from the side of the stages near Concepción. What happened, and what my clips show.

sections.p: Rally Chile 2019 was the first edition of Rally Chile. It ran from May 9 to 12, 2019, on gravel roads through pine forest.
I watched from the side of the stages near Concepción, Biobío, Chile, and filmed on my phone. Many of the clips replay the pass at 1/4 speed.
It was round 6 of 14 in the 2019 World Rally Championship.
Ott Tänak and co-driver Martin Järveoja won in a Toyota Yaris WRC.

list: A white car and a green car passing very close to where I stood.
A Hyundai WRC car sideways on gravel.
A Škoda rally driver up close.

sections.p: Slowing a pass to 1/4 speed gives you time to see how a car sits sideways on gravel. A pass that is over in a blink becomes something you can study.

sections.h2: From the stage side to the sim

sections.p: If a car sideways on gravel makes you want to try it, start with my guide to rallycross and dirt racing in iRacing.
